build_radial_mlp: build a RadialMLP neural network with configurable channel widths for radial basis function embeddings
create_polynomial_envelope: create a PolynomialEnvelope module with a configurable exponent for smooth cutoff of radial distances
create_gaussian_smearing: create a GaussianSmearing module to embed distances into a fixed number of Gaussian basis functions

review_polynomial_envelope_forward: review the PolynomialEnvelope forward method that applies a smooth polynomial cutoff to scaled distances
